note: Generic starter taxonomy. 'labeling' (long descriptions) labels chunks at index time; 'routing' (short descriptions) routes each message. Topic and sub names must match exactly on both sides. Rename/restructure to fit YOUR logs, then run `jevmem index --relabel`.

work.desc: The user's job: meetings, tasks and deadlines, coordination with colleagues or clients, status updates, planning documents, work email and chat.

sub.meetings: Meetings and calls: agendas, meeting notes, decisions made, action items, who attended, follow-ups after a meeting.
sub.tasks-deadlines: Assigned tasks, to-do lists, priorities, deadlines, estimates, what was finished or postponed at work.
sub.communication: Work messages and email: requests from colleagues or clients, replies drafted, announcements, notifications that needed action.
sub.planning-docs: Specs, requirements, proposals, reports, slide decks, roadmaps and other planning or reporting documents for work.

coding.desc: Software development and tooling: writing code, debugging, code review, builds and deploys, developer tools, the agent's own scripts and automations.

sub.bugs-debugging: Errors, stack traces, failing tests, root-cause investigations and the fixes that resolved them.
sub.code-review-deploy: Pull requests, code review comments, merges, CI pipelines, releases and deployments.
sub.tools-setup: Developer environment and tools: editors, CLIs, package managers, config files, API keys setup, machine maintenance.
sub.agent-automation: The assistant's own scripts, hooks, scheduled jobs, memory system and automation rules: creating, fixing or tuning them.

side-projects.desc: Personal projects outside the main job: product ideas, apps or games being built, content creation such as videos, blog posts or newsletters.

sub.ideas: New ideas and concepts: brainstorming, naming, pros and cons, whether an idea is worth pursuing.
sub.building: Hands-on progress on a personal project: features built, design decisions, prototypes, launches.
sub.content: Creating content: video scripts and edits, blog posts, social media posts, thumbnails, publishing schedules.

learning.desc: Learning and research: books, courses, articles, papers, new technologies or skills the user is studying, notes and takeaways.

sub.reading-courses: Books, courses, tutorials, talks and videos consumed for learning, with notes and takeaways.
sub.research: Investigating a question in depth: comparing options, benchmarks, market or technical research, summaries of findings.

health.desc: Physical and mental health: exercise, sleep, energy, diet, symptoms, doctor visits, medication, stress.

sub.exercise-diet: Workouts, running, walking, sports, meals, diet changes and weight.
sub.sleep-energy: Sleep quality, tiredness, energy levels, stress and mood over a day.
sub.medical: Symptoms, injuries, doctor or dentist visits, tests, medication and recovery.

family-home.desc: Family, relationships and home life: family members, kids, partner, friends, household chores, errands, home plans and events.

sub.family-friends: Family members, children, partner, friends: their news, plans, conversations, caring for them.
sub.home-errands: Household chores, repairs, groceries, errands, moving, home setup.
sub.events-plans: Birthdays, holidays, gatherings, trips with family, reservations and schedules for personal events.

hobbies-media.desc: Leisure: music, movies, series, games, sports watching, travel and outings, recommendations and personal taste.

sub.music-video: Music, playlists, concerts, movies, series, streaming, recommendations and opinions about them.
sub.games: Video games or board games played, progress, impressions.
sub.travel-outings: Travel, day trips, restaurants, cafes, places visited or planned.

admin-money.desc: Personal admin and money: budget, bills, subscriptions, purchases, taxes, insurance, contracts, official paperwork and accounts.

sub.finance: Budget, savings, investments, bills, subscriptions and their costs, expense tracking.
sub.purchases: Things bought or considered: product comparisons, orders, deliveries, returns.
sub.paperwork: Taxes, insurance, contracts, government or bank paperwork, passwords and account administration.

smalltalk.desc: Casual conversation that needs no past memory: greetings, thanks, short reactions, jokes, chit-chat, simple acknowledgements.

sub.greetings-thanks: Hello, good morning, good night, thanks, see you, simple acknowledgements like ok or got it.
sub.chitchat: Jokes, short reactions, casual remarks and small talk with no specific topic.
